36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
126451: A blonde-haired, blue-eyed girl who transferred into Hanako's midde school. Both of her parents are non-Japanese, and her appearance might make you think she knows English, but she's actually really bad at it because she was born and raised in Japan.
126452: An energetic and bright girl who can both play sports and hit the books. However, that doesn't mean she's the sharpest knife in the drawer.
126453: A girl who appears to be a goody-two-shoes who reads book in the classroom after school, but she's actually extremely unskilled at English. She asks Olivia to teach her English.
127451: Hanako's family servant. Maeda has vowed to always assist and teach Hanako, even if it means lying to her as to appear all knowing and helpful, he's been doing that since her childhood though, she does act more disdainful towards poor Maeda but both still are fairly close.
132203: She is a smart, bespectacled girl whose real name has not been revealed. Despite her timid demeanor, she managed to win her position with a speech that sounded threatening to the rest of the student body.
132662: Hanako and Olivia's classmate who takes Olivia's place in the English speech contest. Everyone thinks she's good a classical Japanese because of her appearance but she's actually fluent in English, because of her trouble with the Japanese language she prefers to talk in English.
133229: Oka is the leader of the Occult Research Club and essentially its sole member who befriends the Pastimers Club, teaching them occultic games.
133230: She is a feminine-presenting classmate who the Pastimers suspect of actually being male, leading them to go to great lengths to uncover Tsugumi's true identity. Tsugumi keeps their identity ambiguous and enjoys teasing the club in return.
133938: Younger brother of Hanako Honda. Not much is known about him but he seems to show strong care for Hanako.
194891: Takayanagi is the school guidance councilor who is rather manly in appearance. She has an equally manly younger sister in her third year who is president of the Swimming Club.
194892: One of the legendary Four Lords of Pastimers, she is a student of a prestigious nearby all-girls academy and introduced by one of Chisato's friends - a teacher at that school. She dropped by during Episode 4 to socialize with the Pastimers Club.
199524: Vice President supports Student Council President as a part of the student council. Vice-President doesn't actually do much, though, so most of the paperwork and club management duty ends up being completed by President.
210460: Aguri Matou, nicknamed Agrippa, is Oka's fellow member in the Occult Research Club. She was temporarily out of school for medical reasons.
